ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: I picked Petrel because the query is a straightforward factual explanation paired with a clear formatting constraint ("don't ramble — just explain it"). Petrel leads on the benchmarks that matter most for this: MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 75.9) and GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 56.2) for accurate science content, and IFEval (89.8 vs 85.3) for reliably following the "be concise" instruction. The task is neutral-tone and transactional, which both models tolerate fine, so there was no preference reason to route away from Petrel — leaving its capability advantage as the deciding factor.
